reply: Losing a photon flips parity, so the stripes fade while the blobs stay. At 2.1 the cat holds 4.41 photons, and parity above 0.9 means those stripes were real.
The buffer is slow: the ratio is 0.29, so the memory overshoots by 56% and the converged peak is 6.89 before it settles near 4.41. The short buffer underestimates that peak by 11%.
It rings at 3.14 MHz and needs 1.13 µs to settle. A quicker piece is near 0.73 µs, and the quality factor is 2.46.
